result.title: CARE: Contrastive Representation Learning with Environment-Invariance Regularization for Behavioural Intention Prediction
result.summary: Trajectory-based behavioural intention prediction faces environmental variation, and representations learned with a pooled contrastive objective may retain environment-specific regularities. We present CARE, a self-supervised trajectory-learning framework that couples temporally asymmetric contrastive views with an invariant-risk-minimisation (IRM)-style gradient penalty on environment-wise contrastive risks. Each input window yields an anchor, a partially masked positive view, and a temporally perturbed negative view. Masked reconstruction and observability-aware evidence consistency complement this objective by promoting temporal information retention under partial input. On an IMPTC-derived four-class intention task, CARE achieves 0.840 accuracy and 0.023 expected calibration error (ECE) under IID fine-tuning, and 0.806 accuracy with a Brier score of 0.308 on the reported held-out environment. Under frozen-encoder linear probing, reconstruction provides the largest individual held-out accuracy gain, whereas the complete objective yields the lowest held-out ECE (0.049) among tested variants. These results support the combined objective as a competitive representation-learning approach under the evaluated shift, while the IRM-style regulariser is not taken as evidence of formal invariance.

AI.brief_summary: CARE 面向轨迹驱动的行为意图预测，用时间非对称对比视图（锚点、局部遮蔽正样本、时间扰动负样本），叠加按环境分组的 IRM 式梯度惩罚，辅以遮蔽重建与可观测性感知的证据一致性目标，并在 IMPTC 四分类任务上报告 IID 与留出环境下的准确率、ECE 和线性探测结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 用冻结编码器线性探测与重建增益检验「部分输入下保留了什么信息」，以及用环境不变性惩罚抑制环境特异规律，可能为核查 latent 状态是否保留任务必要信息、以及跨分布偏移的泛化提供评价线索；但该文属轨迹意图预测，不涉及 latent 推理状态的生成与使用，迁移价值需阅读原文核查。
